proof_assessment.monotone_closure: Correct. Prefix lower l and suffix upper u are nondecreasing; every feasible chain lies between them. l<=u makes either l or u a feasible chain, including zero horizon and all-time cap.
proof_assessment.contiguous_bounds: Correct and sharp over the interval-monotonicity information polytope. The stated upper and lower witnesses satisfy every original interval and adjacent ordering.
proof_assessment.upper_witness: Before b choose l_i; from b choose max(l_i,u_b). Then F_a=l_a,F_b=u_b and the value is u_b-l_a.
proof_assessment.lower_witness: Let c=min(u_a,l_b). Before a choose min(u_i,c); from a choose max(l_i,c). Since l_a<=c<=u_a, this gives F_a=c,F_b=l_b and value max(0,l_b-u_a).
proof_assessment.endpoint_projection: Exact. Every feasible chain projects to [l_a,u_a]x[l_b,u_b] intersect x<=y. Conversely, any such pair(x,y) extends by F_i=min(u_i,x) for i<a; F_i=max(l_i,x) for a<=i<b; F_i=max(l_i,y) for i>=b. Hence vertex extrema of the clipped rectangle are exact for the normalized endpoint linear objective.
proof_assessment.endpoint_objective: At fixed positive b_a,b_b, F_b/b_b-F_a/b_a is linear in the two endpoint latent values. Clipped-rectangle vertices suffice, including degenerate boundaries, subject to R6_DIAGONAL.
proof_assessment.correlated_lift: Correct for a common N,E pair: charge and thermal-particle changes cancel; binding+fast+retained energy is identically zero. Independent reservoir interval corners are not joint events.
proof_assessment.reference_decomposition: s(F_b/b_b-F_a/b_a)=s(F_b-F_a)/b_b+sF_a(1/b_b-1/b_a). Full differentials in s,b_a,b_b preserve this identity at a frozen witness.
proof_assessment.clock_average: Integrated increments are clock invariant. Average_eta=(dt/deta)*average_proper is valid for supplied positive bin widths; an arbitrary endpoint H does not replace dt/deta.
proof_assessment.manufactured_clock: eta(T)=T/Tstar+(T/Tstar)^2 gives deta=(T_b-T_a)*(1/Tstar+(T_a+T_b)/Tstar^2), positive on the frozen nonnegative horizons.
proof_assessment.nonsmooth_boundary: No unconditional smooth derivative of an active max/min vertex is established or required. Witness/interface JVP scope is correctly restricted.
